newsitem.title: UK: S&P rates Independent Insurance Co.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Independent Insurance Co.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said on Wednesday it had assigned its A claims paying ability rating to Independent Insurance Company Ltd (Independent).

"Independent is the principal operating subsidiary of the Independent Insurance Group Plc (the group) and is based in the UK, where it is a mid-sized writer of commercial and personal lines non-life insurance business, sourced exclusively through the intermediary market," S&P said in a statement. S&P noted the following positve rating factors.
- Excellent earnings track record and good future prospects.

"These strengths are partially offset by Independent's lack of geographic diversity, its unbalanced exposure to liability lines, the threats posed by the continuing development of direct underwriting methods, and its relatively modest, albeit adequate, prospective risk-based capitalisation," S&P said.

- The high regard that Independent enjoys within the broker community will prove beneficial as it pursues growth, although organic growth rates are unlikely to significantly exceed 12 percent during the next few years.
- Return on revenue will stabilise at a long-term average of approximately six percent.
- Risk-based capital adequacy will decline somewhat to relatively modest, albeit satisfactory levels.
